review_kind: Independent read-only semantic review by the distance-preserver proof worker; no compiler run
findings: Compared with Definitions 5.2/5.4 and Claim 3 in arXiv v6. Filtered actual darts encode ordered forward/backward cycle steps; extra-safe divides the budget by two, including bucket zero. Concatenation permits empty blocks and boundary backtracking.

The existing chord bound forces total cycle steps below n, excluding any supported base-only cycle. Every remaining supported cycle contains a bucket chord, has weight at most (2+2*eps)*k*2^i, and contradicts the (2+8*eps)*k weighted-girth threshold.

Positive eps and k>=1 are explicit; graph weights>=1 come from the unit-cycle certificate. Non-backtracking plus acyclic support implies the block is a path. Disjoint half-open dyadic buckets then prevent cross-block chord repetition.
scope: Claim 3 and actual definitions only. No global simplicity or dispersion theorem is assumed or proved. Hiker construction, counting and the final lightness theorem remain open.
